subject: CloudWave partnership: AWS Marketplace sell-with onboarding & SKU mapping
messages:
From: Eve Parker <eve@cloudwave.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: Amit Joshi <amit@cloudwave.com>, Alexa Sato <alexa@aws-partner.com>
Date: 2026-04-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Partnership inquiry — AWS sell-with listing for CloudWave + Redwood

Hi Vivek —

Thanks again for the quick intro. CloudWave builds a managed data enrichment layer that complements Redwood's inference offering; we think a sell-with listing inside AWS (private offer + managed onboarding) would accelerate joint trials with several mutual ISV prospects.

High-level asks from our side:
- Confirm Redwood supports sell-with (managed listing) and private offers in AWS Marketplace.
- Technical evidence required for listing: SOC2 summary, SSO integration guidance, and basic metering expectations.
- SKU strategy: do we bundle as a co-sell SKU or list as separate products with entitlement mapping?
- Proposed timeline: go/no-go for a pilot in Q3; can we start a joint intake this month?

I've attached a short overview and can share SOC2 artifacts on request. Would love a 30-min sync next week to map responsibilities (tech, pricing, legal).

Best,
Eve Parker
Head of Partnerships, CloudWave
[attachment: CloudWave_Partner_OnePager.pdf (pdf)]

From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Eve Parker <eve@cloudwave.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, olga_petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-19T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Partnership inquiry — AWS sell-with listing for CloudWave + Redwood

Eve —

Really excited about this. Short answers up front: Redwood supports sell-with flows and private offers (we've done managed onboarding with two ISVs last year). Happy to run intake.

Next steps I propose:
1) Quick kickoff call (30 mins) to confirm scope and timeline — I can do Tue 4/21 10:00am PT or Wed 4/22 2:00pm PT.
2) CloudWave to share SOC2 summary, sample usage profiles (per-tenant qps, token rates), and SSO requirements.
3) Our partner ops (Olga) will draft SKU mapping options: co-sell bundle vs. separate entitlements.
4) Karthik will do a preliminary metering/price-recommendation with your usage samples.

Olga/Ben/Karthik — please see the asks above and flag any immediate blockers.

Eve — if you can drop the artifacts into the Drive link I created (and paste the link back in a reply), we'll triage and prepare the intake checklist.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | vivek@redwood.ai

--
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Alliances
Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, olga_petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-19T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Partnership inquiry — AWS sell-with listing for CloudWave + Redwood

Adding a few pragmatic notes from GTM/ops perspective:
- SKU mapping: Typically we recommend a single co-sell SKU that embodies the integrated offering (easier for joint quoting). However, if CloudWave needs independent billing, we can do separate SKUs with entitlement mapping. Need to know whether CloudWave expects reseller margins or revenue share.
- Metering: Attach a quick template — we need samples of peak qps, average tokens/day by tenant, and retention windows. I've attached 'MeteringMapping.xlsx' that we use for initial scoping.
- Legal: Private offers can require a short SOW; legal will want to see SOC2 and data handling notes.

If CloudWave can confirm expected monthly spend bands (pilot vs scale), that'll speed up a pricing recommendation from Karthik.

Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Channel & Partnerships
Redwood Inference
[attachment: MeteringMapping.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Eve Parker <eve@cloudwave.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: Amit Joshi <amit@cloudwave.com>, Alexa Sato <alexa@aws-partner.com>
Date: 2026-04-20T08:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Partnership inquiry — AWS sell-with listing for CloudWave + Redwood

Vivek / team —

Thanks for the fast responses. Quick answers and uploads:
- Uploaded CloudWave SOC2 summary and SSO diagram to the Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_CloudWave-Onboard (files: CloudWave_SOC2_summary.pdf, SSO_SAML_diagram.png).
- Attached 'usage_samples.csv' with per-tenant QPS and token-per-call estimates. Pilot expected to be in the $8-12k/month band; scale could move to $60k+/month depending on customers.
- We prefer a single co-sell SKU for GTM simplicity; CloudWave's finance team is open to a revenue share split (tbd).

On the 30-min call: Tue 4/21 10:00am PT works for us. I'll bring Amit (product) to cover technical integration. Alexa from AWS will join to advise on private offer flow.

Forwarding the SOC2 doc in case legal wants to start review.

Best,
Eve

Subject: Re: Partnership inquiry — AWS sell-with listing for CloudWave + Redwood — kickoff confirmed

Quick status and action items after reviewing the uploads:

1) Kickoff: Confirmed Tue 4/21 10:00am PT — calendar invite sent.
2) Action owners:
   - Olga: draft two SKU options (co-sell bundle + separate entitlements) and post in Drive by 4/23.
   - Karthik: pricing + metering recommendation using MeteringMapping.xlsx + usage_samples.csv by 4/24.
   - Legal (Ben will loop legal): start SOC2/PII intake and flag any special SOW language for private offers.
   - CloudWave (Eve/Amit): prepare a short runbook for onboarding and confirm finance expectations for revenue share.

3) Docs & next steps: HubSpot deal created (CW-2026-0419) and Drive folder linked. Please add any additional evidence to the Drive folder. We'll use the call to finalize intake and agree on a pilot statement of work.

If there are any blockers before the call, flag here. Looking forward to getting this moving.

Thanks,
Vivek
Head of Alliances
Redwood Inference
